content.summary: 4 work items for provider timeout sleep/wake investigation

work_items.title: Unit test proving the 3 timeout config paths in provider fetch wrapper
acceptance_criteria: Test file at packages/opencode/test/provider/timeout-paths.test.ts
Test: no timeout config → no AbortSignal.timeout on fetch
Test: timeout=60000 → AbortSignal.timeout(60000) combined with existing signal
Test: timeout=false → no AbortSignal.timeout, existing signals preserved
All tests pass with bun test

work_items.title: Test simulating stale AbortSignal after sleep/wake (hung fetch)
acceptance_criteria: Test file at packages/opencode/test/provider/sleep-wake-timeout.test.ts
Test: hung fetch with no timeout causes observable hang
Test: hung fetch with AbortSignal.timeout eventually throws TimeoutError
Test: TimeoutError is classified as retryable by SessionRetry.retryable
All tests pass with bun test

work_items.title: Test proving error classification gaps for timeout-like errors
acceptance_criteria: Test file at packages/opencode/test/provider/error-mapping-timeout.test.ts
Test: DOMException TimeoutError through fromError — document actual classification
Test: DOMException AbortError through fromError — control case
Test: ETIMEDOUT SystemError through fromError — document classification
Test: EPIPE SystemError through fromError — document classification
Test: each error through SessionRetry.retryable — verify retry decision
All tests pass with bun test

work_items.title: Document fix proposal with exact changes and risk assessment
acceptance_criteria: Proposal addresses default timeout, TimeoutError handling, and post-sleep error codes
Each fix includes exact file+line, before/after, risk assessment
Includes validation plan
No code changes (investigation boundary)
